verdict.rationale: Stripe's hosted MCP server lists payouts and balance transactions among its supported methods, and its generic `stripe_api_read` tool can call any GET endpoint, so an agent can pull this data directly. Restricted API keys and OAuth scope that access safely. `stripe_report` can also create payouts and balance report runs as downloadable CSVs, which gives the agent material for deposit-level reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking each payout's balance transactions back to the underlying charges (e.g., a payout-itemized reconciliation flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the reconciliation.
